objectives.text: Convert a half into quarters to find equivalent fractions with a common unit
successCriteria: I can show that 1/2 is the same amount as 2/4
I can say why the pieces must be the same size before I count them
assessmentPoints: Opening answers about how much pizza was eaten in total
Thumbs check after the animation: is 1/2 equal to 2/4?

objectives.text: Add fractions with related denominators by counting unit pieces
successCriteria: I can work out 1/2 + 1/4 = 3/4 by counting quarters
I can write the working in one line: convert first, then count
assessmentPoints: Guided count-along answers in the third activity
Worksheet answers in the paired practice

objectives.text: Explain why the denominators are never added
successCriteria: I can say what goes wrong if I add the bottom numbers
I can spot the trap answer 2/6 and explain why it is too small
assessmentPoints: Responses when the trap is sprung in the fourth activity
Exit recap answers naming the rule

activities.title: Surface prior ideas: how much pizza in total?

differentiation.support: Sentence starter: I think the total is ... because ...

activities.title: Watch a quarter fit inside a half

differentiation.stretch: Ask pairs how many eighths would fit inside a half, and why.

differentiation.support: Compare the trap answer with the pizza picture side by side.
